Container.Name: manifold
Container.Overview: Self-hosted MCP gateway. One container serves many MCP endpoints, each registered in claude.ai as its own connector. Reached only through Cloudflare Tunnel. Port 8800 is bound to 127.0.0.1 on the NAS via Extra Parameters so cloudflared (host networking) can reach it and the LAN cannot. Do not add a port mapping in the Port fields.
Container.Requires: A Cloudflare Tunnel whose cloudflared container runs with host networking, with a public hostname mcp.mannylab.cloud routed to http://localhost:8800.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: All persistent state: SQLite config store, encrypted credentials, audit log.

Config.Name: Master key
Config.Description: Base64 output of `openssl rand -base64 32`. Store it in a password manager first. Losing it loses every stored credential.

Config.Name: Admin emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated emails allowed through Cloudflare Access to the admin UI and API.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public origin, used for OAuth redirect URIs and endpoint URLs shown in the UI.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: debug, info, warning or error. Boot default; the UI setting overrides it once loaded.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Leave as /data. Only the container path; the host path is the Data mapping above.
